group.name: Select the body-hair packs you have installed

plugin.name: Nordic Warmaiden Body Hair
plugin.description: Enables female pubic, armpit, stomach, butt and back styles from Nordic Warmaiden Body Hair.

plugin.name: HIMBO V3 Bodyhair Overlays for Racemenu
plugin.description: Enables male arm, hand, armpit, butt, back, stomach, chest, leg and foot hair overlays from the HIMBO body-hair pack.

plugin.name: Pubes Forever Female / Pubic Hairstyles All In One CBBE
plugin.description: Enables the female pubic-hair overlays supplied by Pubes Forever Female / Pubic Hairstyles All In One CBBE.

plugin.name: Pubes Forever Male
plugin.description: Enables the male pubic-hair overlays supplied by Pubes Forever for Males.

plugin.name: OPubes NG compatibility
plugin.description: Installs the OPubes NG compatibility provider. Keep OPubes itself installed; BodyHairSliders does not redistribute its assets.

plugin.name: More Pubes for SlaveTats
plugin.description: Enables 48 female pubic-hair textures from More Pubes for SlaveTats. SlaveTats itself is not required by BodyHairSliders; the original texture pack must remain installed.

plugin.name: Natural Pubic Hairstyles
plugin.description: Enables the 65 female RaceMenu body-paint pubic hairstyles supplied by Natural Pubic Hairstyles.

plugin.name: Yes - Extended overlay slots (Recommended)
plugin.description: Installs a minimal skee64_custom.ini with Body=20, Hands=10 and Feet=10 overlay slots. Recommended when BodyHairSliders reports no free RaceMenu overlay slots.

plugin.name: No - Keep my existing RaceMenu overlay configuration
plugin.description: Does not install skee64_custom.ini. Choose this if another mod already manages that file and already provides enough Body/Hands/Feet overlay slots.
